title: First United Bank & Trust Welcomes Jane Haines as Vice President, Mortgage Relationship Manager
summary: First United Bank & Trust is pleased to announce that Jane Haines has joined the bank as Vice President, Mortgage Relationship Manager, bringing 35 years of banking experience, a proven record of success in mortgage lending, and longstanding ties to the North Central West Virginia community.
body_markdown:
MORGANTOWN, WV –[First United Bank & Trust](http://mybank.com/) is pleased to announce that Jane Haines has joined the bank as Vice President, Mortgage Relationship Manager, bringing 35 years of banking experience, a proven record of success in mortgage lending, and longstanding ties to the North Central West Virginia community.


Recognized as a top mortgage lender by loan production volume in North Central West Virginia, Haines has built her career on strong relationships, personalized service, and a commitment to helping individuals and families achieve homeownership.


Haines brings extensive banking leadership experience to her new position. Prior to joining First United, she spent 19 years with Clear Mountain Bank, serving as Vice President, Mortgage Specialist. Earlier in her career, she was one of the founding officers of Centra Bank, contributing to the establishment of the community banking institution. Her 35-year banking career combines leadership experience, mortgage lending experience, and a deep understanding of the financial needs of individuals and families throughout the region.


A graduate of West Virginia University, Haines earned a bachelor’s degree in Accounting and a Master of Professional Accountancy.


Beyond her professional accomplishments, Haines has demonstrated a longstanding commitment to community leadership, nonprofit governance, and volunteer service. She currently serves on the Board of Directors of the United Way and was recognized as the 2026 United Way Advocate of the Year for her dedication to the community.


Her community leadership experience also includes previous service on the boards of directors for Make-A-Wish, PACE Enterprises, the Rape and Domestic Violence Information Center (RDVIC), and Habitat for Humanity. In addition she has served as co-chair of the LJ Haines Memorial Run, helping support charitable efforts within the community. Through these roles, Haines has devoted her time and leadership to organizations focused on strengthening communities and improving lives.


“Throughout my career, I’ve always believed that mortgage lending is about more than financing a home. It’s about building relationships, earning trust, and helping people achieve their goals,” said Haines. “I’m excited to begin this new chapter with First United and continue serving the clients, Realtors, and builders who have placed their confidence in me over the years. While my bank may be changing, my commitment to those relationships remains the same.”


In her new role, Haines will continue to focus on residential mortgage lending, working closely with homebuyers, Realtors, and builders throughout North Central West Virginia.


Haines will be located at the First United Bank & Trust Suncrest Community Office, and can be reached at304-282-1555 ,jhaines@MyBank.com or at[MyBank.com/jane](https://jhaines-mybank.mortgagewebcenter.com/responsive/#/ApplyNow) . (NMLS #: 742969)


First United Corporation operates one full-service commercial bank, First United Bank & Trust. The Bank has a network of community offices in Garrett, Allegany, Washington, and Frederick counties in Maryland, as well as Mineral, Berkeley, and Monongalia counties in West Virginia. First United’s website can be located at MyBank.com. As of 9/30/2026, the corporation posted assets of $2.1 billion.
